title: Music/sound synthesis
author: FireDragon21976
selftext:
There's alot of videos of people getting some amazing graphics from Astra and Fable, but how good is the sound synthesis of frontier models?   I have gotten some decent sounds out of Fable, but some of the music synthesis is just on the level of high quality midi.  The only realistic music effect I got was in one of my games, I got a very realistic flute sound because I specified the flute be created through physics simulation.

These demo tracks are taken from one of my games I'm working on, a hex wargame loosely based on Avalon Hill's Platoon.  I

The music track was procedurally generated using Fable 5.1.  It plays in the menu, along with other tracks.  The second is a demo reel of sound effects.  Everything is one-shot prompt.  The sounds and music were procedurally generated using Fable 5.1.  Background was generated using GPT Astra from a small icon used in the game (Fable 5.1 chose the image to use).
